chunks: From him, from his father, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya ibn Imran Al-Halbi, from Ayoub ibn Al-Hurr, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him). Sallam said to him: 'Khaysama ibn Abu Khaysama narrates from you that he asked you about Islam, and you said to him: Islam is he who faces our Qiblah, testifies our Shahadah, performs our Nusk, befriends our Auliya, and enmies our A'adwa, so he is a Muslim.' He said: 'Khaysama spoke the truth.' I said: 'And he asked you about Iman, and you said: Iman is belief in Allah, and affirmation with the Book of Allah, and that Allah is not disobeyed.' He said: 'Khaysama spoke the truth.'
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Islam and Iman according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) distinguishes between Islam as the external submission manifested through specific communal markers—such as Qiblah, sacrifice, and Wilayah—and Iman as the internal spiritual conviction rooted in monotheism and fidelity to the Divine Book. This hadith is pivotal in Shia theology for establishing that true faith encompasses both outward adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's authority and inward sincerity, a concept often linked to the Quranic verse 'You will not attain righteousness until you spend from that which you love.'

en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Bin Imran Al Halby, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’farasws, so Sallam said to himasws, ‘Khaysama Ibn Abu Khaysama narrated from youasws that he asked youasws about Al-Islām. So youasws said to him: ‘Al-Islām is from the acceptance of ourasws Qiblah, and testify ‘شَهَادَتَنَا’ ourasws testimonies, and performing ourasws rituals, and befriend ourasws friends, and be inimical to ourasws enemies, so (only then) he become a Muslim’. So heasws said: ‘Khaysama spoke the truth’. I said, ‘And he asked youasws about the Emān, so youasws said: ‘The Emān in Allahazwj, and the ratification with the Book of Allahazwj, and that he would not disobey Allahazwj’. So heasws said: ‘Khaysama spoke the truth’.
en.sarwar: 5. From him from his father from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya ibn ‘Imran al- Halabi from Ayyub ibn al-Hurr from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I was in the presence of abu Ja’far (a.s.) when Salam said, ‘Khaythamah ibn abu Khaythamah narrates to us from you that you were asked about Islam and you said, ‘Islam is this: Whoever faces our Qibla (direction of Makka), testifies to our testiment of belief, practices our practice, is a friend of our friend and an enemy of our enemies, he is a Muslim.’ The Imam said, ‘Khaythamah has told the truth. ’ 1 then said, ‘He had asked you about belief and you said, ‘It is belief in Allah, to acknowledge the book of Allah and not to disobey Allah.’ He said, ‘Khaythamah has told the truth.’”
